name: Gentouka
source:
"My life belongs to you. Use it as you please, Tamayori-hime."
A god with the power to bestow eternal life on other people, because of this he is constantly being pursued by people who want to take advantage of him. 
His life was saved by the Tamayori-hime so he pledged allegiance to her.
